basis_note: All figures SOLO basis, from South Bangla Agriculture & Commerce Bank PLC's own audited financial statements and 'Highlights on the overall activities of the bank' annexure. The bank was licensed in 2013, so FY2013 is its first year and this series (FY2013-FY2025) is its entire public history to date; there is no FY2011/FY2012. FY2017's balance sheet and P&L are recovered from the FY2018 report's audited comparative column because FY2017's own report's financial-statement pages did not extract (not a scan; a pdftotext table-extraction failure). FY2025 carries a qualified audit opinion (provision shortfall of Tk.1,023.57 crore against required provision of Tk.1,379.40 crore); FY2025's classified-loans/NPL figures are the only ones found in extractable text and are Consolidated-basis (a close proxy for Solo, since the bank's only subsidiary does not lend).
